issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite conventions requiring test-first coverage for every feature including authorization paths.
CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] was not updated despite docs-sync conventions.
Docs ER diagram drops entities.locale_default which the task did not ask to remove.

conventions.evidence: Migrations have reversible down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entities_table.php:415-418, 2026_10_29_000002_create_entity_memberships_table.php:450-453), $fillable set (app/Models/Entity.php:24-27, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:83-87), policies used for auth, docs/database-schema.md updated; but TDD violated (no tests) and CHANGELOG.md + policy PHPDoc missing

readability.evidence: Clear names, small focused methods, sibling HasFactory generics, no dead code; e.g. app/Models/User.php:172-175 membershipFor, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:288-291 delete delegates to update

requirements.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:29-31 getRouteKeyName slug, :37-60 memberships/users/owner; database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entities_table.php:406-411 entities_slug_unique + softDeletes; 000002:436-446 cascade FKs, role default employee, owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_entity_user_unique + entity_memberships_one_owner; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:270-298 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:219-246 match task auth rules; docs/database-schema.md owner_membership_id replaced

security.evidence: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:270-298 (create true, view member-only, update/delete owner/admin, manageSettings owner-only) and app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:219-246 (view any member, assignRole owner/admin, delete never-owner + self-or-owner/admin); $fillable deliberate; no Blade/Livewire output or secrets

scope.evidence: All hunks serve task: app/Models/*, app/Policies/*, database/factories/*, 2 migrations, docs/database-schema.md; no routes/pages/middleware/translations/invitations/queues/billing

simplicity.evidence: Lean direct Eloquent + policies with no service layers; reuse via membershipFor; e.g. app/Models/UserRole.php:198-201 manageable, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:288-291 delete reuses update

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-522 contains zero tests/* or *Test.php files; no happy-path, edge-case, or unauthorized-call coverage

review.summary: Implements entities/memberships persistence, models, UserRole, policies, factories and docs update correctly with portable single-owner DB enforcement. Missing the mandatory Pest/PHPUnit test suite, so it needs substantial rework before merge despite strong requirements, security and simplicity.
